title: Exact patient and encounter
prerequisites: Every bound source matches requested scope and authorized historical baseline link
eligible_result: Allow bounded source display
otherwise: Withhold foreign source and dependent result; audit mismatch
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Exact review interval and cutoff
prerequisites: Scope, repository, ingestion watermark, canonical digests and full-precision boundary correspondence confirmed
eligible_result: Accept one coherent snapshot
otherwise: Withhold projection; no join of unrelated RF1/RF2 snapshots
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Revision and duplicate handling
prerequisites: Logical specimen/collection identity and predecessor chain resolvable
eligible_result: Show terminal eligible revision; retain originals in history
otherwise: Do not add duplicates or resurrect a withdrawn predecessor
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Unknown is not zero
trigger: Absent source or broken device stream
prerequisites: Explicit documented zero or confirmed stopped treatment
eligible_result: Display true zero on its assessed interval
otherwise: Show missing/unknown and preserve coverage gap
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Baseline selection
prerequisites: Reviewed original candidate/date, selection rationale and uncertainty
eligible_result: Pin selected baseline with alternatives
otherwise: Show baseline unavailable; no default eGFR back-calculation
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Historical baseline linkage
prerequisites: Authorized patient match, dates and policy-specific lookback
eligible_result: Use explicit historical candidate
otherwise: Do not treat another encounter as current evidence
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Chronicity
prerequisites: Longitudinal supporting records and approved CKD profile
eligible_result: Display established source classification or governed result
otherwise: Single abnormal test does not establish CKD
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Absolute creatinine change
prerequisites: Distinct eligible specimens, comparable units/calibration and precise chronology
eligible_result: Evaluate >=0.3 mg/dL rise within 48h under KDIGO2012 profile
otherwise: Indeterminate for missing interval/specimen/unit; correction is not new sample
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Relative creatinine change
prerequisites: Eligible baseline, current specimen and evidence of known/presumed onset within profile window
eligible_result: Evaluate >=1.5-fold rise; retain baseline uncertainty
otherwise: Withhold relative criterion without baseline/onset evidence
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Creatinine stage 1 or 2
prerequisites: Approved published population profile and sufficient coherent creatinine evidence
eligible_result: Stage1: eligible ratio >=1.5 and <2, or absolute rise >=0.3 mg/dL within48h; stage2: ratio >=2 and <3; record exact branch
otherwise: Do not label no AKI when other criteria are indeterminate
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Creatinine stage 3
prerequisites: AKI context established; approved age-specific profile; actual source values
eligible_result: In established acute injury assess ratio >=3 or rise to >=4.0 mg/dL; preserve timing and actual acute-KRT branches separately
otherwise: High chronic baseline alone is not an incident AKI assertion
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Urine stage 1
prerequisites: Complete eligible interval and weight; <0.5 mL/kg/h for >=6h but <12h under approved interpretation
eligible_result: Record independent urine criterion
otherwise: Do not use incomplete collection/blocked catheter as established renal oliguria
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Urine stage 2
prerequisites: Complete eligible >=12h interval and weight; <0.5 mL/kg/h
eligible_result: Record independent urine stage branch
otherwise: Gaps or disputed continuity prevent duration claim
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Urine stage 3
prerequisites: Eligible <0.3 mL/kg/h over >=24h or anuria >=12h with complete/patent collection
eligible_result: Record branch and supporting interval
otherwise: No anuria diagnosis from absent charting or blocked catheter
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: KRT-associated stage
prerequisites: Actual support for acute kidney indication; chronic maintenance excluded
eligible_result: Retain KRT criterion distinct from creatinine/urine
otherwise: Order/preparation/chronic dialysis cannot automatically establish incident stage 3
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Combined assessment
prerequisites: Each criterion has met/not_met/indeterminate state
eligible_result: Report highest established eligible stage, noting unassessed branches
otherwise: No stage zero/recovery claim from partial negative evidence
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Population-specific eligibility
prerequisites: Known adult/child/neonate/pregnancy context and approved exact population profile
eligible_result: Run only applicable definition
otherwise: No adult default; pediatric eGFR branch requires dedicated validation
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Collection duration
prerequisites: Explicit start/end, interval_total semantics, complete collection, comparable mapped volume
eligible_result: Volume divided by exact elapsed duration; label original total
otherwise: A six-hour total cannot be interpreted as one hourly observation
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Overlap and cumulative totals
prerequisites: Distinct collections with nonoverlapping accounted coverage
eligible_result: Aggregate included nonduplicated collections
otherwise: Cumulative/interval/emptying entries not added blindly
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Patency and irrigation
prerequisites: Collection patency and irrigation accounting documented
eligible_result: Present collection finding and need for clinical review
otherwise: No renal-anuria attribution with obstruction/loss uncertainty
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Conventional eGFR
prerequisites: Approved equation/population/input calibration; steady-state suitability assessed
eligible_result: Label equation, indexed units and limitations
otherwise: Flag rapid change/KRT/unknown suitability; do not use as acute true filtration
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Cockcroft–Gault
prerequisites: Explicit applicable label, demographics, eligible creatinine and selected weight method
eligible_result: Label eCrCl mL/min and formula/version
otherwise: Never relabel eGFR as eCrCl or silently choose actual/ideal/adjusted weight
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Measured clearance
prerequisites: Complete timed collection, mapped concentrations/volume and representative plasma sample
eligible_result: Label measured CrCl method and validity interval
otherwise: Do not label measured GFR or extrapolate across intermittent rebound
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: BSA deindexing
prerequisites: Explicit BSA method and valid source height/weight; source indexed estimate
eligible_result: Calculate eGFR * BSA/1.73 with original indexed result retained
otherwise: No assumed BSA or changed denominator label
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Fractional excretion
prerequisites: Paired eligible plasma/urine analytes, units, timing and medication context
eligible_result: Display FENa/FEurea as limited contextual result
otherwise: No automatic prerenal/ATN diagnosis; confounders visible
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Urgent electrolyte concern
prerequisites: Confirmed assay/context, actual clinical concern and treatment/response assessment
eligible_result: Escalate concern to responsible clinician under approved pathway
otherwise: No universal K threshold or autonomous dialysis order
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Acid-base, overload or uremic concern
prerequisites: Clinical significance and alternatives/refractoriness reviewed where applicable
eligible_result: Route urgent clinician review and acknowledgement
otherwise: Do not diagnose urgency from a single creatinine/BUN value
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Timing of KRT
trigger: Severe AKI without established urgent indication
prerequisites: Individual clinical trajectory, goals and responsible specialist review
eligible_result: Record considered strategy and next review
otherwise: No universal accelerated start from severe AKI alone; never delay an urgent indication
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Poisoning support
prerequisites: Toxin/level/time, clinical context and approved toxicology guidance
eligible_result: Specialist-directed modality/plan review
otherwise: No general creatinine-based toxin clearance decision
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Modality and scope
prerequisites: Reviewed indication, consent, access, population and supported modality/device profile
eligible_result: Versioned authorized prescription intent
otherwise: Unsupported modality remains record-only, no fallback to CRRT equations
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Solution compatibility
prerequisites: Exact final formulation, role, circuit and approved device compatibility
eligible_result: Permit documentation of checked connection
otherwise: No inferred electrolytes from product name; unknown composition blocks dependent calculation
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Order versus actual
prerequisites: Actual flow/volume/time observation, not an order or start intent
eligible_result: Build explicit confirmed running segments
otherwise: Do not extrapolate continuous delivery from a single start event
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Segment transitions
prerequisites: Close prior interval and pin new prescription/device/solution context
eligible_result: Split integration at actual event time
otherwise: Unknown transition time remains a gap; never carry IHD into CRRT dose
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Downtime union
prerequisites: Explicit start/end, reason and known stopped versus telemetry missing
eligible_result: Union overlapping documented downtime within reporting window
otherwise: Unknown gaps reported separately; no double-counted interruptions
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Measured effluent
prerequisites: Measured nonduplicated bag/counter volume, resets/weights/calibration known
eligible_result: Report measured volume and coverage
otherwise: Cannot substitute net patient removal for gross effluent
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Estimated effluent
prerequisites: Confirmed actual settings/intervals and device-specific effluent accounting
eligible_result: Integrate exact piecewise rates, labelled estimate
otherwise: No integration across unknown rate/gap; no citrate/PBP double count
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Weight-normalized dose
prerequisites: Explicit approved weight purpose/reference and valid kg mapping
eligible_result: Show both mL/h and mL/kg/h with weight/time basis
otherwise: No automatic latest/dry/dosing weight substitution
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Wall versus on-treatment denominator
prerequisites: Full-window coverage plus run-time and selected weight
eligible_result: Show distinct wall-time and on-treatment effluent surrogates
otherwise: Do not hide downtime by reporting only running-hour intensity
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Predilution effect
prerequisites: Approved membrane/model/profile, measured Qb, Hct, replacement location/flow
eligible_result: Apply documented dilution model with assumptions
otherwise: Do not apply one dilution factor to all CVVHDF transport; no measured-clearance label
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Measured solute clearance
prerequisites: Paired plasma/effluent concentrations and representative effluent flow
eligible_result: Compute method-specific clearance with uncertainty
otherwise: Effluent volume alone is not proof of delivered solute clearance
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Net patient fluid removal
prerequisites: Machine convention and extra circuit inputs/returns explicitly mapped
eligible_result: Publish net-removal summary to M9 once with source identity
otherwise: Gross effluent is not removal; machine net rate alone is not whole-patient balance
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Intensity review
prerequisites: Clinician-approved target with actual coverage and weight
eligible_result: Flag discrepancy for review; include electrolyte context
otherwise: No automatic intensification or fluid-removal change
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Calcium sample separation
prerequisites: Systemic and postfilter site/type labels known
eligible_result: Display separate results and protocol target authority
otherwise: No sample-site substitution or universal target
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Calcium ratio eligibility
prerequisites: Total and systemic ionized calcium, compatible molar units, valid temporal pairing and sample quality
eligible_result: Ratio with exact paired refs, timing and unit conversion
otherwise: Mixed mg/dL and mmol/L, postfilter sample or unmatched times withhold ratio
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Possible accumulation
prerequisites: Ratio/context trends, calcium requirement, acid-base/perfusion/liver/lactate context
eligible_result: Show concern for expert review under approved profile
otherwise: No standalone ratio diagnosis or reflex pump change
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Citrate stopped, calcium continues
prerequisites: Actual contemporaneous delivery states and named protocol
eligible_result: Urgent coordinated clinician/nurse check per approved policy, preserving uncertainty
otherwise: Do not automatically stop calcium; systemic replacement may still be clinically required
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Blood-flow or modality change
prerequisites: Actual event and new supported protocol prescription
eligible_result: Prompt coordinated citrate/calcium/solution review
otherwise: No carry-forward prior infusion targets or inferred safe state
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Bleeding and HIT context
prerequisites: Concurrent anticoagulants, labs/clinical bleeding and applicable expertise
eligible_result: Record individualized strategy and monitoring
otherwise: No default citrate/heparin order or automatic contraindication from one liver value
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Circuit alarms and pressures
prerequisites: Native channel/sign, model, timestamps, signal quality and local approved response
eligible_result: Display native alarm with acknowledgement and bedside check
otherwise: No autonomous alarm suppression or machine control
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Electrolyte/temperature adverse events
prerequisites: Actual current specimen/measurement and local critical-result policy
eligible_result: Route accountable human review with recorded response
otherwise: No unapproved universal supplement/cooling protocol
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Renal dose review
prerequisites: Actual exposure, source-specific label, estimate applicability, delivered modality and TDM
eligible_result: Create/reconcile review task in medication owner including M6 antibiotics
otherwise: No duplicate drug library or silent dosing change
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Nutrient and substrate effects
prerequisites: Actual product/delivery and measured or approved modeled loss/contribution
eligible_result: Link versioned estimate to M14 with assumptions
otherwise: No universal amino-acid loss or complete citrate metabolism assumption
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Daily continuing indication
prerequisites: Current indications, native function and actual support context
eligible_result: Record continue/defer/trial-off decision and owner
otherwise: No automatic discontinuation from one creatinine/urine threshold
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

prerequisites: Actual off-time, monitoring/escalation plan and new modality if any
eligible_result: Preserve old episode, open new segment, trigger medication review
otherwise: No recovery declaration from dilution or extracorporeal clearance alone
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Access and discharge
prerequisites: Last actual KRT, recovery uncertainty, catheter indication and follow-up owner
eligible_result: Handoff exact sources and confirmed next plans
otherwise: No implied catheter removal or completed appointment from a plan
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Stale review
prerequisites: Draft signature equals current canonical snapshot
eligible_result: Record manual review pinned to original evidence
otherwise: Keep draft text; require explicit discard/new review before recording
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: Uncertain save and recovery
prerequisites: Exact request canonical body/digest and confirmed lookup outcome
eligible_result: Recover original request before any deliberate retry
otherwise: No duplicate append or alternate request after unconfirmed completion
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

title: History race and scope
prerequisites: Generation and exact selected reference/snapshot still match
eligible_result: Show exact history from original source owner
otherwise: Discard late response; retain error instead of unrelated successor
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.

prerequisites: Confirmed current data, reviewer, rationale, next step and next review
eligible_result: Page-session review with explicit persistence limit
otherwise: Never imply chart sign-off, scheduled task or durable record
execution: Decision support for human review only; no orders or device commands.
